description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The categories, representing language families, are listed on the vertical axis, labeled “Language Family” with entries including “IE-Slavic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Germanic”, “Uralic”, “IE-Baltic”, “IE-other”, “IE-Indic”, “Semitic”, “Turkic”, and “Basque”, listed in descending order based on task count. The horizontal axis, labeled “# tasks”, represents the number of tasks, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each language family is represented by a single, solid-colored bar. The “IE-Slavic” family has the longest bar, extending to approximately 74 tasks, while the “Basque” family has the shortest bar, extending to approximately 1 task. The bars are colored in a variety of shades, including blue, green, red, orange, and yellow, with no apparent pattern related to language family. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
